out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Two spray bottles of cleaning solution were stored on the clean equipment shelving next to the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. The PIC moved the two spray bottles during the inspection to correct.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Clean equipment and utensils were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization on the shelving next to the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. The PIC spread the equipment out so it would air dry during the inspection.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. The permit was not posted.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. The manager found the 2025 permit in the back of the establishment and posted it. Please post the 2026 permit as soon as possible.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. Manager cannot locate the employee health policy for the establishment during the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. Provide the EHS with your employee health documents within three days.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There are no paper towels in the restroom..
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The PIC corrected this during the inspection. CDI. Impact Mosaic (Inspection Date: 02/13/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: two containers of cooked chicken in the Vevor hot holding unit was 122°F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The holding temperature of the unit was 145°. Recommend setting it to 165° to keep chicken 135° and above at all times. The PIC reheated the chicken to 165° to correct. CDI.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Two bottles of Windex were stored with food, equipment, and food on top of the counter freezer in the back.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. The PIC moved the bottles of Windex in the inspection to correct. CDI.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Observed a live adult cockroach in the employee bathroom.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. Recommend having your pest control company look into this issue within the next 10 days. Roaches are hiding behind or under the hand sink or in the wall it’s attached to.

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equipment/Utensils Air Drying
violations.observation: Observed several stainless steel and plastic food containers were found stacked while wet after cleaning and chemical sanitization.
violations.corrective_action: After cleaning and sanitizing, equipment and utensils shall be air-dried or used after adequate draining before contact with food. Correct as soon as possible or before the next routine inspection.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of foods. Mayonaisse and Home Depot buckets were being reused.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. Discontinue reusing manufacturer containers. Remove all manufacturer containers before the next routine inspection. Only food grade containers may be used to store food.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Mechanical Ventilation System Capacity
violations.observation: Ventilation is not sufficient to keep rooms free of excessive obnoxious odors. The establishment has a strong fryer oil odor which can also be detected outside the establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Provide mechanical ventilation at a sufficient capacity to minimize soiling of walls, ceilings, and equipment; efficiently remove obnoxious odors and toxic fumes; and prevent the creation of hazards or nuisances involving the accumulation of fats, oils. Recommend having the ventilation system service to ensure that it is working properly.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. CDI permit posted. BUSINESS LICENSE MUST ALSO BE POSTED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at the warewash area is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. Observed hot water knob broken and water temperature at 86f
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. CDI knob fixed. Hot water restored

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink, in the employee bathroom.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

out_items.name: Food-contact surfaces cleaned and sanitized

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the BUCKETS with a concentration of 0ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. CDI Chemical storage

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: countertop juicer, dicer, and grinder heavily soiled.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CDI cleaned. These items must be cleaned at least every 4 hours while in use. And stored cleaned.

out_items.name: Proper hot holding temperatures

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cooked chicken left on the counter at 125/128F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI discarded

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: countertop cooler at 51f and food above 41f, under counter reach in cooler and 2dr upright cooler very tightly packed to prevent air circulation, items 43f-51f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI discarded

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Windex stored on cutting board/prep table top, quat sanitizer stored over open case of cabbages.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. CDI chemicals removed

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the quat solution was measured at 500ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment. Observed test strip was blue at the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of quat solution at 400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: cooling chopped vegetables and mixed sauces in coolers over packed with product, preventing proper air circulation. Product observed in deep plastic containers with lids on, further preventing proper cold air circulation to cool the product.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. CDI items removed from fridge, placed in freezer to cool. Discussed cooling.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: countertop cooler at 51f and 2dr upright cooler at 44f inside.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Cooler air filters cleaned, maintenance man called. Standing refrigerator restored to 39f. Counter cooler observed at 60f. Follow up for cooler maintenance. Discussed using TIME CONTROL for counter top cooler items to be discarded every 4 hours.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Toilet room door is not provided with a self-closing door.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door BEFORE FOLLOW UP.

out_items.name: Certified Food Protection Manager

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. Observed no certified food manager on duty at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EHS INSTRUCTED OWNERSHIP AND MANAGEMENT TO ENSURE A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER IS PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION TO INCLUDE PREPARATION, SERVICE, AND CLEANING/SANITIZING. THE CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. EHS observed staff entering the facility and changing tasks without washing hands.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EHS DISCUSSED WITH OWNERSHIP ABOUT WHEN TO WASH HANDS. BARE HANDS SHOULD BE WASHED AFTER ENTERING THE FACILITY, CHANGING TASKS, CHANGING GLOVES, TOUCHING PERSONAL BODY, AND RETURNING TO WORK AFTER USING THE BATHROOM. ENSURE CONTINUED CORRECTION BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided in the employee bathroom.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. OWNERSHIP PLACED A ROLL OF PAPER TOWELS IN THE EMPLOYEE BATHROOM. PLEASE ENSURE THE BATHROOM ALWAYS HAS PAPER TOWELS AND A PAPER TOWEL HOLDER IS INSTALLED ON THE WALL BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION. Impact Mosaic (Inspection Date: 01/29/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: EHS observed food items, that were prepared this morning being cooled in a prep top refrigerator that is not designed for rapid cooling of foods.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS DISCUSSED WITH OWNERSHIP THAT FOOD PREPARED IN THE MORNING NEEDS TO BE COOLED TO 41f BEFORE BEING HELD IN THE COLD HOLDING UNIT. FOOD SHOULD BE PREPARED EARLIER AND COOLED IN THE UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR OR FREEZER BEFORE USE. OWNERSHIP PLACED LIDS ON FOOD ITEMS. PLEASE TRAIN STAFF BEFORE THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed in zip-top bags and shakers without a label: salt, sugar, dried spices, and dried grains.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH OWNERSHIP ABOUT LABELING. FOOD THAT WAS TAKEN OUT OF THE ORIGINAL CONTAINER AND PLACED INTO ANOTHER CONTAINER NEEDS TO BE LABELED. PLEASE MAKE THIS CORRECTION BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food on Display, Guards/Packaging
violations.observation: The food on display is not protected from contamination. EHS observed no barrier between the prep line and the customer waiting line.
violations.corrective_action: Food on display shall be protected from contamination by the use of packaging, counter, service line, or salad bar food guards, display cases, or other effective means. OWNERSHIP AGREED TO COVER ALL OF THE FOOD IN THE COLD HOLDING UNIT ON THE PREP LINE UNTIL A GLASS SNEEZE GAURD CAN BE INSTALLED. PLEASE SEND DOCUMENTATION WITHIN 10 DAYS TO ENSURE THAT A GLASS SNEEZE GAURD HAS BEEN INSTALLED.

violations.corrective_action: EHS DISCUSSED WITH OWNERSHIP ABOUT INSTALLING A SELF-CLOSING HINGE OR CLOSING MECHANISM. PLEASE CORRECT THIS BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
